details.completeness_justification: All HIGH-importance criteria (K1-K7) are fully represented in the candidate summary. K8 (partner network expansion) is the only omission and is of MEDIUM importance, so the overall picture remains substantially complete.
details.coherence_justification: The candidate summary is internally coherent. Each sentence builds logically on the previous ones without contradictions. Growth metrics (ARR, revenue) are presented consistently, profitability improvements are explained by cost control and revenue growth, and SaaS metrics are reported with clear directional changes. Organizational flow moves from financial performance to operational metrics, customer developments, and forward guidance without repetition or logical gaps.
